node.title: Re^3: converting JSON to CSV
node.author: shmem
node.doctext:
Just TIMTOWTDI...

[AnomalousMonk] already [id://1187365|mentioned] the issue with [doc://local]. Localizing is pointless when it happens at top level - in the same way as [doc://my] variables are global variables if declared at top level in a program that consists in just 1 file without imports.

So, [doc://local] needs a place. A bare block is convenient: my $text; # but see above ;-) { local( $/, *FH ) ; open( FH, '<', 'aws.json' ); $text = ; } # $/ restored to default here # FH is an empty typeglob in the symbol table

See also [id://94027]
